acceptance_criteria: Add a Flange QC v2 artifact intake template bundle with dataset manifest, evaluation report, model artifact manifest, and camera boundary readiness artifact.
Add a validator CLI that checks an intake directory and validates all four artifacts using existing contract-first validators.

Validator rejects raw media/model files, secrets-like files, missing required artifacts, mismatched dataset/model/eval references, labels outside the dataset label set, production authority, model promotion, and live camera enablement.
Validator emits JSON with ok/errors/warnings/next-step readiness so a future issue can be opened from the result.
Docs explain how to copy/fill the artifact bundle and which next issues are allowed after validation.
Required local checks pass and no restricted behavior is introduced.

memory_preflight.query: flange_qc_v2 artifact intake dataset model camera handoff validator
retrieved_decisions: Dataset/eval/model/camera must enter through metadata contracts.
Raw data, weights, secrets, and hardware enablement remain restricted.
Codex is the only coding worker.
retrieved_lessons: Prepare integration boundaries before real artifacts arrive.
Make validator output explicit enough to open the next DoR-ready issue.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-023 PR to remove the intake templates, validator, tests, docs, and gate evidence. No production data migration, model rollback, hardware rollback, or deploy rollback is required.
